name: Onya no Ko no Kimochi
source:
Yuzuka is a gifted student preparing to enter a very prestigious college. Tragically, she is singled out by a gangster and his stooges on the train to school. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE066481.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
柚香是一名天才学生，正准备进入极其名门的大学。不幸的是，她在上学乘坐的电车上被一名黑帮及其爪牙盯上。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE066481.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
